description:
Spalding, a Saalex Company  is seeking a  SharePoint Power Platform Developer  in  Patuxent River, MD .  Spalding, a Saalex Company is a professional services company delivering cutting-edge solutions to the Department of War. Our expert-level solutions include software development, information technology, program management, financial management and business intelligence services. 
 Position Type:  Full-time
 Salary:  $110k-$150k annually (depending upon experience)
 Work Location:  Full-Time onsite. 
 Essential Functions: 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain custom M365 applications using:
 Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI)
 SharePoint Framework (SPFx)
 Related technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, REST APIs, Graph API).
 Support the administration and troubleshooting of SharePoint and SharePoint Online (SPO) sites, ensuring functionality and resolving technical issues.
 Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, develop solutions, and ensure SharePoint and Power Platform implementations align with business needs.
 Conduct technical research, introduce innovative IT solutions, and provide recommendations on SharePoint interfaces and applications.
 Develop and maintain user documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials for SharePoint and Power Platform applications.
 Requirements 
 Required: 
 Experience developing, testing, and troubleshooting Microsoft Power Platform applications (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI).
 Experience developing custom experiences using SharePoint Framework (SPFx), including SharePoint REST API and Graph API integration.
 Experience designing, configuring, building, and maintaining SharePoint lists, libraries, and sites.
 Experience gathering business requirements and developing IT solutions to meet organizational needs.
 Highly Desired: 
 Experience with React.js development including REST and/or Graph API within the SPFx.
 
 Education/Experience:  
 BS/BA or AA/AS degree and 7 years related experience OR HS and 9 years related experience.
 
 Security Clearance:  
 Must be eligible to obtain a Secret clearance.  Active Secret clearance desired, interim Secret acceptable to start. Requirements to obtain a clearance include US Citizenship, security investigation, etc.  
 Benefits 
 Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
 Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
 Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
 Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
 Short Term & Long Term Disability
 Training & Development
 Wellness Resources
 Stock Option Benefit
